name: ward
description: Recover from Ward denials and inspect its ambient Codex safety kernel.

interface.shortDescription: Recover from Ward denials and inspect health.
interface.longDescription: Ward guides the current Agent after a high-confidence destructive veto and provides explicit diagnostics for its ambient Codex safety kernel. Ordinary deferred work receives no Ward intervention, permission grant, or added prompt.
interface.defaultPrompt: Recover safely from a Ward denial or explain a Ward session-health warning. Stay silent for ordinary deferred requests, and run Doctor only through an already-authorized Host path.
